facts.fact: Vanguard reports a federal circular (No. 59805/S.I/74, dated 27 July 2026) directing all ministries, departments and agencies to comply fully with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.
Vanguard reports an NDPC statement, signed by its Head of Legal, Enforcement and Regulations, with Dr Vincent Olatunji as National Commissioner and CEO.

Vanguard reports the circular requires MDAs to submit their data protection officers' names to the NDPC for registration and to file compliance audit returns, and that the NDPC constituted a regulatory clinic giving technical support to MDAs on compliance.
